clauses.quote: The School Board will vote to determine whether such recommended disciplinary action shall be effectuated.
clauses.notes: Internal board procedure for finalizing disciplinary recommendations.

clauses.quote: Nothing contained in this policy shall be interpreted to conflict or supersede any provisions of the Alabama Fair Dismissal Act or the Teacher Tenure Law.
clauses.notes: Savings clause preserving statutory worker protections against policy override.

clauses.quote: The Board shall comply with the provisions of Policy No. 3095 in those instances where the law allows an employee to request a conference with the Birmingham School Board in regard to a disciplinary action recommended by the Superintendent.
clauses.notes: Cross-references another policy but imposes a clear compliance duty benefiting employee conference rights.

clauses.quote: The assignment and transfer of personnel shall be decided by the Birmingham Board of Education on the recommendation of the Superintendent.
clauses.subject_text: The assignment and transfer of personnel
clauses.notes: Passive construction; subject is the assignment/transfer, but operative duty rests with the Board.

clauses.quote: All transfers shall be made in accordance with applicable Federal and State laws
clauses.notes: Elliptical subject; requires management to ensure transfers comply with applicable laws.

clauses.quote: and shall not be made for personal or political reasons.
clauses.notes: Elliptical subject; prohibits management from making politically motivated transfers, protecting worker job security.

clauses.quote: All public employees must constantly uphold the integrity of the profession in all actions and relations with pupils, colleagues and the community.
clauses.notes: Conduct duty imposed on employees to protect institutional integrity.

clauses.quote: The professional educator obeys all laws
clauses.notes: Imposes a general legal compliance duty on educators.

clauses.quote: holds high moral and ethical standards
clauses.notes: Aspirational conduct standard without operative legal effect.

clauses.quote: and renders professional service to the best of his ability.
clauses.notes: Aspirational conduct standard without operative legal effect.

clauses.quote: The professional educator will abide by the policies set forth by the Birmingham City School System.
